rubricScores.criterion: Listed the projects that were built as part of the solution
Identified that LrgWindowsAppManifest was referenced but not included in the solution build
Noted the configuration (Debug vs Release) used for the missing project vs the referencing project
Connected the dots: project not in solution → builds with stale/wrong config → output in wrong path

scenarios.scenario: Insight — Determine which projects are in the solution vs referenced
scenarios.reasoning: The agent followed a reasonable investigation workflow — checking overview, errors, projects, properties, and searching — but drew an incorrect conclusion on the central question. It misidentified LrgWindowsAppManifest as being part of the build when it was actually only referenced, not built. This fundamental misdiagnosis meant it couldn't identify the root cause (project not in solution leading to wrong/missing output). The project listing was vague, and the configuration analysis was superficial. The error description was accurate but the analysis fell short.
